claim: Dated community and SDK source recheck retained the native foundation; independent configuration/source review confirmed existing terminal profiles and selected ECC hashes. Authenticated native Claude displayed context, six connected MCP servers, HUD and zero then nonzero usage around a real inherited-tool review. Manual compaction was exercised separately.

commands.mode: interactive PTY in the existing adopted project

limitations: Dated bounded baseline, not exhaustive landscape saturation, comparative superiority or full sixteen-layer lifecycle E2E.
No new package installation or global account/model/permission change. Unchanged upstream installation and behavior evidence retains its prior scope.
Source/currentness review is not native SDK acceptance. Existing worker recovery does not qualify another role, SDK, host crash, distributed effects or provider cancellation.
Manual compaction and selected continuity checks do not establish automatic compaction, every retained fact or general recovery reliability.
Context and HUD numbers are estimates; usage display includes rounded auxiliary requests. Complete session/provider usage and causal savings remain unknown.
The named restricted starter reviewer remains conditional; this native review used inherited tools with a no-edit instruction, not OS-enforced read-only access.
Model reviewers independently inspected bounded files. Supported findings were resolved; agreement and artifact hashes are not substitutes for behavioral acceptance.

Private native session logs retained outside Git. Public exports normalize paths; screen observations are coordinator records, not all contained in the context export. Windows dropdown interaction was not tested.
